title: Got a game idea? Redbean helps you build it in 10 mins - all on your phone. (Free now!)
author: tuanquanghpvn
selftext:
Let’s be honest, we’ve all had that one game idea.

But the second you try to make it? You hit a wall: code, tools, engines, tutorials, asset packs. Suddenly, it’s like you need a whole game dev degree just to build one idea you had in the shower.

So we built Redbean - a place where you can turn your ideas into playable games just by chatting. No complicated engines. No code. No laptop needed. Just you, your phone, and a wild idea.

# How it works:

* Input your idea (text, sketch, or image)
* Chat with an AI agent to brainstorm, pick mechanics, or generate logic
* Publish your game instantly inside the app
* Explore and remix games from other users - or let them remix yours

Try it out, make something small. Or weird. Or genius. It’s your game.

It’s FREE now and we can’t wait to see what you’ll create (and hear what you think!)
